review.decision: Use current committed contract for P0; retain historical fingerprints and all existing reference baselines.
material_changes: Linux private desktop/AT-SPI route permits physical GPU UI tests without macOS VM.
Device-recovery GUI/CLI comparison selects observed numerical backend; CPU/GPU parity remains independently tested.
Seven macOS transport self-tests were removed upstream; this is a validation coverage reduction, not deletion of catalog cases.
limitations: Review is static plus current portable suite self-tests.
No native Linux/macOS GUI or physical GPU case executed for Pancake.
Stored ChimpStackr Linux 376/376 record is historical external-target evidence, not a new independent replay.

skip_reasons: Two native smoke wrappers require explicit target and GUI route.
Two Linux-only routing/boundary self-tests skipped on Darwin.

scaffold_gates.meaning: Documentation-only scaffold checks passed; no executable application tests or application coverage exist. This does not satisfy real-code P0 assurance qualification.
